historical_sequence_reconstruction.ambiguity_policy: stop before clustering if a historical entry cannot be assigned one unambiguous sequence
historical_sequence_reconstruction.entity_selection_rule: match the historical saved residue order to all candidate BMRB entities and require one unique best identity-consistent entity
historical_sequence_reconstruction.preferred_source: full BMRB entity sequence from the frozen Entity_comp_index snapshot

combined_sequence_universe.node_unit: one selected BMRB entity sequence per entry; historical anchors remain separate provenance nodes even when their sequence is identical

connected_components.algorithm: undirected connected components over all exact verified homology edges
connected_components.component_identifier: SHA256 of the lexicographically sorted member node identifiers, prefixed with v15hc_
connected_components.duplicate_sequence_policy: identical sequences remain in the same component
connected_components.singleton_policy: a sequence with no passing edge forms one singleton component

balancing_variables.name: total_sequence_length
balancing_variables.normalization: 0.10 times eligible unanchored sequence length total

deterministic_allocation.component_order: ascending SHA256 of allocation_seed, component_id, and sorted member candidate_ids

sequential_assignment.candidate_choice: choose the component minimizing the sum of squared normalized deviations from that role's entry, paired-target, and sequence-length targets
sequential_assignment.exact_objective_tie: break by frozen seeded component order
sequential_assignment.procedure: allocate complete unassigned components to each reserved role in frozen priority order
sequential_assignment.stop_for_role: stop when the role entry target is reached or exceeded

deterministic_allocation.target_basis: unanchored feature-eligible new entries remaining after historical-external quarantine
deterministic_allocation.target_calculation: for each reserved cohort, target entries equal the larger of its frozen minimum and round-half-up of 0.10 times the eligible unanchored entry count
deterministic_allocation.training_assignment: all remaining eligible components plus v14-development-anchored components

discovery_parameters.coverage_mode: query coverage; both query directions retained
discovery_parameters.maximum_hits_per_query: at least the complete database size

exact_verification.exact_duplicate_supplement: exact normalized sequence groups are connected independently of MMseqs2 output
exact_verification.x_containing_sequence_supplement: every sequence containing X is compared against the full combined universe using the exact verification definition

historical_anchor_precedence.component_with_both_anchor_types: historical_external_quarantine takes precedence; record the conflict and stop for audit if any previously inherited training row would otherwise enter training

highest_priority.effect: all new entries in the component are excluded from v15 training, validation, internal test, and new external blind evaluation

second_priority.effect: new entries in the component are training-only

homology_edge_definition.coverage_definition: aligned standard-amino-acid positions divided by the number of standard-amino-acid positions in the shorter sequence
homology_edge_definition.edge_symmetry: undirected; an edge is retained once the exact symmetric definition passes
homology_edge_definition.identical_sequences: always connected when at least one scorable standard residue is present
homology_edge_definition.identity_definition: identical aligned standard-amino-acid positions divided by aligned positions where both residues are standard amino acids

post_allocation_validation.insufficient_training_policy: do not weaken homology isolation, move opened external entries, split components, or train a model; report attainable training size and stop
required_checks: every eligible new entry has exactly one role
no connected component spans multiple roles
no exact BMRB identifier spans multiple roles
no exact PDB identifier spans multiple roles
no training or evaluation role contains a component anchored to opened v14 external data
new external blind meets its minimum entry count
internal test meets its minimum entry count
model-selection validation meets its minimum entry count

prohibited_actions: using row order, BMRB ID, PDB ID, or chain ID as a scientific allocation variable
using target values, residuals, predictions, or model metrics during allocation
opening the new external blind cohort before final evaluation
opening the internal test before model selection is complete

sealed_state.internal_test: not opened until model selection is complete
sealed_state.model_selection_validation: only cohort eligible for model selection
sealed_state.new_external_blind: entry identifiers, targets, and feature shards are copied to a sealed manifest before model training; no metrics, residuals, or predictions are calculated
